title: Chemical Potential of the Generalized Hubbard Model with Correlated Hopping
abstract: In the present paper we study chemical potential of the generalized Hubbard model with correlated hopping. The peculiarity of the model in comparison with similar generalized Hubbard models is the concentration dependence of hopping integrals. Chemical potential as a function of the model energy parameters, electron concentration and temperature is found. It is shown that correlated hopping and temperature changes essentially the chemical potential location; these dependencies differ strongly at different values of the electron concenntration.
